mergewith.subtemplate:
<substModel id="ABySS.s:$(n)" spec="abyss.substitutionmodel.ABySSubstitutionModel" symmetric="false"> <rates id="rates.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam" domain="PositiveReal" dimension="$(nrates)" value="1.0" estimate="true"/> <!-- TODO nrates --> <frequencies id="freqs.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.substitutionmodel.Frequencies"> <frequencies id="freqParameter.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.SimplexParam" dimension="$(nstates)" value="1/$(nstates)"/> <!-- TODO nstates --> </frequencies> <rateIndicator id="indicators.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.BoolVectorParam" dimension="$(nrates)" value="true" estimate="true"/> <!-- TODO nrates --> </substModel>
<distribution id="ratesPrior.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Dirichlet" param="rates.s:$(n)"> <alpha spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam" domain="PositiveReal" dimension="$(nrates)" estimate="false" value="1.0"/> </distribution>
<distribution id="freqPrior.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Dirichlet" param="freqParameter.s:$(n)"> <alpha spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam" domain="PositiveReal" dimension="$(nstates)" estimate="false" value="4.0"/> </distribution>
<distribution id="indicatorPrior.s:$(n)" spec="abyss.distributions.SVSPrior" indicators="@indicators.s:$(n)" nrOfStates="$(nstates)"> <scale id="svsScalePrior.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Uniform"> <param id="svsScale.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real" value="1.0"/> <lower id="svsScaleLower.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real" value="0.1762"/> <upper id="svsScaleUpper.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real" value="2.0"/> </scale> </distribution>
<distribution id="eigenfriendlyRatesPrior" spec="abyss.distributions.EigenFriendlyQPrior" nrOfStates="$(nstates)" rateIndicator="@indicators.s:$(n)" rates="@rates.s:$(n)"/>
<operator id="ratesAVMN.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.AdaptableVarianceMultivariateNormalOperator" beta="0.05" burnin="500" initial="1000" weight="0.1"> <transformations id="ratesLogSumTrans.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.Transform$LogConstrainedSumTransform"> <f idref="rates.s:$(n)"/> </transformations> </operator> <operator id="ratesExchanger.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.DeltaExchangeOperator" delta="0.1" weight="0.1" parameter="@rates.s:$(n)"/> <operator id="freqExchanger.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.DeltaExchangeOperator" delta="0.01" weight="0.1" parameter="@freqParameter.s:$(n)"/> <operator id="indicatorBitFlipper.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.BitFlipOperator" parameter="@indicators.s:$(n)" uniform="false" weight="0.2"/> <operator id="indicatorScaler.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@svsScale.s:$(n)" upper="10.0" weight="0.1"/>
